title: Median lifespan: lean-fed vs overweight-prone dogs (years)

source.name: Effects of Diet Restriction on Life Span and Age-Related Changes in Dogs (Kealy et al., JAVMA 2002)

notes: Landmark 48-dog lifetime study: lean-fed Labradors had a median lifespan of 13.0 years vs 11.2 years for full/control-fed littermates -- a 1.8-year gap.
